name: binance-klines
note: Hourly candles for the pair in the URL: [openTime, open, high, low, close, volume, ...].

name: ths-klines
note: Daily candles as a compact string: date,open,high,low,close,volume,amount per row. The hs_ prefix covers Shanghai and Shenzhen; other boards need their own adapter entry.

name: tradingview-chart
note: TradingView streams its candles over the page's own WebSocket, so no HTTP request can fetch them. `sniff` registers the MAIN-world stream sniffer for the hosts in sniffMatches, which reads the frames the chart is already receiving; capture then reports the charted symbol and its newest bars. Open the chart first — the sniffer only sees what arrives after the page loads.
